text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The time has come for a 1,600-meter race—the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's only thanks to my blood, sweat, and tears that I've gotten this far.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: After that, I'm heading for 2,000 meters, and then 2,500 meters… reaching the apex of the Bakushin Road with more distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to take my first big step—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm still taking my first step… as a senior racer? This is my senior year, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't think this is what the Bakushin Road means at—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list: Let's win and make you into the Mightiest Miler!
Let's win and make you into the Mightiest Miler!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Got it! All aboard the Bakushin Boat and full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll show you what three years' worth of hard work can do!
